question: Sum of three consecutive integers is 24. Find the integers.
A boat goes 30 km upstream and 44 km downstream in 10 hours. In 13 hours, it can go 40 km upstream and 55 km downstream. Determine the speed of the stream and that of boat in still water.
A car goes uphill at the rate of 30 km an hour and downhill at the rate of 50 km an hour after 15 hours it has covered 650 km. How long did it go downhill and uphill respectively?

A train covered a certain distance at a uniform speed. If the train would have been 6 km/hr faster it would have 8 hours less than the scheduled time, and if the train were slower by 6 km/hr,it would have taken 12 hours more than the scheduled time. Find the length of the journey.
The coach of a cricket team buys 7 bats and 6 balls for $3800. Later, he buys 3 bats and 5 balls for $1750. Find the cost of each bat and each ball.
The difference between two numbers is 26 and greater number is three times the smaller. Find the numbers.
The sum of two numbers is 35. Their difference is 13. Find the numbers.
Two angles of a triangle are the same size. The third angle is 12 degrees smaller than the first angle. Find the measure the angles.
The second angle of a triangle is three times the first, and the third is 12 degrees less than twice the first. Find the measures of the angles.
The total cost for tuition plus room and board at State University is $2,584. Tuition costs $704 more than room and board. What is the tuition fee?
Mrs. Hilt owns a house on a lot shaped like a rectangle. The width is twice its length. The perimeter of the lot is 60 feet. What is the length and the width of the lot?
The dance troupe used ribbob to form a rectangle. The rectangle was 20 feet long and 15 feet wide. How long was the piece of ribbon?

A length of wire is cut into several smaller pieces. Each of the smaller pieces are bent into squares. Each square has a side that measures 2 centimeters. The total area of the smaller squares is 92 square centimeters. What was the original length of wire?
A triangle has a perimeter of 90 cm. The lengths of the three sides are in the ratio 5:12:13. What is the length of the shortest side?
The ratio of the area of a rectangle to the area of a triangle is 2:5. The rectangle has a length of 6 cm and a width of 4 cm. What is the area of the triangle?
In Mrs. Hutchinson's kindergarten class, children make handprints in a round clay mold for their parents. The mold has a diameter of 4 inches. What is the mold's radius?
A square name tag has sides that are 9 centimeters long. What is the name tag's perimeter?
A truck can hold four boxes. If you needed to move eight hundred seventy-one boxes across town, how many trips would you need to make?
A restaurant needs to buy three hundred eighty-seven new plates. If each box has five plates in it, how many boxes will they need to buy?
A builder needed to buy one hundred fifty-four boards for his latest project. If the boards he needs come in packs of three, how many packages will he need to buy?

A store owner had two employees and bought nine hundred twenty-seven uniforms for them. If he wanted to give each employee the same number of uniforms, how many more should he buy so he doesn't have any extra?
It takes eight grams of plastic to make a ruler. If a company had eight hundred twenty-eight grams of plastic, how many entire rulers could they make?

A school had nine hundred thirty-five students sign up for the trivia teams. If they wanted to have six team, with the same number of students on each team, how many more students would need to sign up?
George had 648 pieces of candy. If he split the candy into 8 bags with the same amount of candy in each bag, how many pieces would each bag have in it?
While playing a trivia game Adam scored 283 points total. If he scored 71 points each round, about how many rounds did he play?
